question_zh: 在 441 日阶梯配方的固定切分上，把 data.feature_set 从 raw 换成 raw_plus_ofi，样本外预测与多空表现是否更好。

environment_only_changes.note: paths only: the host data root, cache root and output root differ from the frozen recipe

budget_points.name: ofi-1.32
budget_points.role: scored anchor: the only exported point

budget_points.name: ofi-stepup-1.33
budget_points.role: driver second point only; checkpoint and predictions are never compared

exposure.reconcile: samples_seen == steps * batch_size; unique/usable coverage >= min_coverage; realised effective epochs within atol of the declared point; 1.32 passes over the pool must therefore cover every usable row

resume.fail_closed: pool, recipe, fitted transforms and sampler order must reproduce the checkpoint exactly; no fallback

derived_reference.calibration: the driver re-derives both points from the pool it builds; the estimate only bounds the declared budget

evaluation_scope.local: replay of the exported per-point weights

driver.note: the driver needs two budget points; only scored_point is exported for comparison and the second point's checkpoint is ignored
